history.content:
<thought>
Directly in front of me is a lava cell, which is deadly and cannot be traversed. To my right (relative to my current orientation), there is an open floor cell. Turning right will allow me to proceed safely along the row and eventually reach the goal.
</thought>
<action>
TURN_RIGHT
</action>

<thought>
Now I am facing right, with the open floor cell directly in front of me. Moving forward will put me on a safe cell, and I can continue to progress towards the area where the goal is located (up and to the left). The immediate path forward is clear.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>

<thought>
The cell directly in front of me is an empty floor and safe to enter. The goal can be seen two cells ahead and one to the left. Moving forward now keeps me safe and brings me closer to reaching the goal.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>

<thought>
I am now next to the goal, which is to my left. To face the goal for a possible forward move, I should turn left.
</thought>
<action>
TURN_LEFT
</action>

<thought>
Now I am facing left. The cell in front of me is a floor and safe. The goal is two cells further ahead in this direction, so moving forward is the correct next step.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>
